## What's Changed
* apps wall: add TapTape by @superkam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2216
* fix(docs): preserve help output with cold Go cache by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2223
* build(deps): bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2 from 1.43.6 to 1.43.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2222
* build(deps): bump github.com/aws/smithy-go from 1.27.8 to 1.27.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2221
* build(deps): bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/credentials from 1.19.36 to 1.19.37 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2218
* build(deps): bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3 from 1.107.1 to 1.107.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2220
* build(deps): bump github.com/bitrise-io/go-utils/v2 from 2.0.0-alpha.37 to 2.0.0-alpha.38 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2219
* fix(notify): keep Slack validation diagnostics concise by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2224
* fix(telemetry): classify snitch descriptions as leaf calls by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2225
* Add deep submission validation by @rudrankriyam in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2226
* apps wall: add Somilo by @nogu66 in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2217

## New Contributors
* @superkam made their first contribution in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2216
* @nogu66 made their first contribution in https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/pull/2217

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI/compare/4.10.0...4.11.0
